requirement: No participant receives a route, non-neighbour identity, membership size, hop count, global balance/objective or coordinator instructions. Actual context-bound SHA-256 hashlock settlement, local bilateral approvals and durable reservations are mandatory.
initial_balances: Uniform signed integer -3 through 3 on a ring plus random distinct undirected original pairs.
preferences: Broad symmetric comfort intervals and hard credit grants of 10000 at both endpoints; explicit assistance opt-in. Named headroom policy may use original zero-balance trustlines. Cancellation cannot.

arrivals.interpretation: First 1000 Poisson events, uniform original trustlines; offers are generated before all runs and arrive independently of clearing activity. Actual bilateral obligation proposal/approval/commit is asynchronous. Some arrivals can reduce debt by bilateral netting. Never equate offered with fully applied.

negative_control.purpose: Preserve evidence of the original broad-zone strict-discomfort initiation stall.

scheduling.interpretation: Independent local exponential wakeups; continuously overlapping searches, approvals and external obligations. Each actor stops new searches at its configured local horizon. Fixed observation window; no queue-empty-triggered arrivals, global epoch barriers, selected initiator or unbudgeted drain. Request safety cap censors the run with pending work retained.

private_nonexpansion: A separately hash-context-bound research policy. Local routing is randomized. Both incident moves must obey bilateral comfort. Every participant's sum of absolute local balance changes must be nonpositive; the initiator's must be strictly negative. No global cost sum is transmitted. This guarantees gross debt reduction for a fully applied loop but excludes some globally useful loops with consecutive helper edges.
metrics: Cumulative actual peer application request attempts and acknowledgement messages/bytes, separately and combined.
Actual endpoint debtor-side debt after local events, with mirror discrepancy and pending reservation counts.

Observer-only quote-consistent reconstruction of fully applied operations, alongside replay of exactly the incorporated external obligations without clearing. This shadow is diagnostic; the main measured curve is actual endpoint debtor-side debt, and pending dependencies remain explicit.
Completed matched hashlock cycles, partial local fulfillment, offers/submissions/fully posted/backlog/rejections; no proposal or readiness counted as clearing.
Discomfort, hard bounds, signed positions and local evidence correctness; all failures, pending work and increasing external-transfer steps retained.
claims: No global completeness or optimum certificate. Node-local and neighbour-private here mean no required remote membership or loop-length content, not anonymity against timing, metadata correlation or collusion. Honest stable identities and reliable transport are assumed for this first campaign; durable SQLite storage and actual hashlocks do not establish Byzantine or permanent-loss recovery.
timing: Fixed simulated clocks and seeded local choices; fresh cryptographic secrets/identifiers and real receipt timestamps remain nondeterministic. One illustrative host runtime per run, not production throughput. Run measurements serially.
freeze: Pin protocol adapter, research policy, observer, auditor, benchmark, fixture generator, plan, inputs and imported app protocol sources before measurements. Preserve previous coordinated-exact evidence as a separate reference.
